caveats: The target tests for links and does not presume they exist.

objectives: Obtain Michigan Skills in Sync award lists and compare recipients with SmartStart participants and curriculum language.
Search Arizona Commerce Authority board materials, Future48 agreements, community-college records and local-government agendas for SmartStart or WEF references.
Search Kentucky cabinet, economic-development finance authority, local development council, school and workforce records for SmartStart or WEF references.
Identify any payments, grants, contracts, memoranda, curriculum licenses, portal procurement or official board votes.
Record explicit negative findings for each jurisdiction if no transaction-level link appears.
data.research_question: Do public state or local records document a SmartStart-related grant, contract, memorandum, curriculum transfer, school selection, workforce-board action or procurement?
selection_reason: Three named contributors hold current state implementation authority.
The highlighted institutions have direct local delivery and funding mechanisms.
A transaction-level test is required before any local-government influence claim can be strengthened.
data.target: SmartStart state and local transaction records

summary: Target official award, contract, agenda, memorandum and implementation records that could connect SmartStart to Michigan, Arizona, Kentucky or their local delivery partners.
title: Find SmartStart state and local transaction records
